svg.title: Reaper complete electronics wiring map
svg.desc: One diagram showing battery, flight controller, ESC, motor, receiver, GPS compass, airspeed, telemetry and five servo connections. Physical connector orientation must be checked on received parts.
svg.text: One diagram for the owned parts. This is a functional net map, not a physical connector-position drawing.
PDB ESC pads: ESC positive + negative
Thin throttle: signal + GND to S1/G
Check actual unit despite OPTO title
Three motor phase wires from ESC
Swap any two only if rotation wrong
Vx -> Vx2 bridge for S5-S7 power
Read actual V2 board pad markings
FC GND -> RX GND; not SENS
AIR TX -> FC RX1; AIR RX <- FC TX1
GPS TX -> FC RX3; GPS RX <- FC TX3
Keep compass away from current wires
USB -> laptop; radio link to AIR unit
Two tubes to ASPD; prove positive reading
3 FIVE MG90S SERVOS - EACH LEAD HAS SIGNAL, +5V AND GND
Use Vx 5V for S3/S4. Bridge Vx to Vx2 for S5/S6/S7 when using the onboard servo BEC.
Propeller off; verify polarity and plug/key order. Isolate ESC BEC red only if live.
Prove loaded Vx/Vx2, controls/failsafe, pitot, motor current/thrust and CG.
Solid lines = electrical route; purple dashed = radio link; gray dashed = air tubes/optional S7.
